faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.subtitle: Everything you need to know before we start working together.

items.question: What services do you offer?
items.answer: We provide full spectrum digital marketing including SEO, LLM/GEO optimization, PPC advertising, social media management, web development, and content marketing. For Web3 projects, we offer community building, GTM strategy, tokenomics advisory, PR, and KOL management.

items.question: How do I get started working with you?
items.answer: The first step is booking a free discovery call where we learn about your business, goals, and challenges. From there, we create a tailored proposal with strategy recommendations and pricing. If it's a fit, we begin onboarding within days.

items.question: What is your pricing structure?
items.answer: Our pricing varies based on scope, industry, and goals. We offer monthly retainers for ongoing partnerships and project based pricing for specific deliverables. During our discovery call, we'll discuss your budget and create a proposal that delivers maximum value.

items.question: How long before I see results?
items.answer: Timeline depends on the service. PPC campaigns can generate leads within days of launch. SEO typically shows meaningful improvements in 3 to 6 months. Community building and brand awareness are ongoing efforts with compounding returns over time.

items.question: Do you work with small businesses or only enterprise clients?
items.answer: We work with businesses of all sizes, from funded startups to established enterprises. What matters most is alignment on goals and a commitment to growth. Our strategies scale to match your budget and ambitions.

items.question: How do you measure and report on results?
items.answer: Transparency is core to how we work. You'll receive regular reports with clear KPIs, insights, and recommendations. We use data dashboards so you can track performance in real time, and we schedule review calls to discuss progress and next steps.

items.question: What makes you different from other agencies?
items.answer: We combine over a decade of marketing experience with modern AI workflows that increase speed and precision. We're hands on, accountable, and treat your growth like our own. Our team has worked with both Fortune 500 brands and leading blockchain protocols.

items.question: Can I book a call to discuss my project?
items.answer: Absolutely. We offer free 30 minute discovery calls to understand your needs and explore how we can help. You can book directly through our calendar or reach out via the contact form on this site.
